Campaigners urge the Albanese government to reject the Hunter Valley Operations coalmine expansion, and Chinese police contact members of a WeChat group that discussed a Melbourne vigil for a HungryPanda rider.
text.europe: Ada Colau, leader of the leftwing Broad Front coalition, calls for a rental revolution and hopes anger over housing wins her support in Spain's snap election on Sunday. Leaked records list 349 Russian deaths in three years in Mali as Moscow props up the junta. South Korea tells residents of Ulleungdo island to take shelter after Russian military aircraft enter its air defence identification zone.
